India's first indigenous bullet train to be tested in 2027

India's first domestically manufactured bullet train is scheduled for track testing between May and June 2027. Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that the train, built in India, will undergo these tests. The inauguration of this indigenous bullet train is also planned for 2027.
